newsitem.title: USA: YPF files shelf for 33.4 mln American Depositary Shares.
newsitem.headline: YPF files shelf for 33.4 mln American Depositary Shares.

text.p: YPF Sociedad Anonima SA filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration for up to 33.4 million American Depositary Shares to be sold in a secondary offering by the government of Argentina.
After the offering, the Argentine government will continue to own about 20.3 percent of the outstanding capital stock of YPF, the filing said.
The proposed maximum aggregate offering is for $1,083,268,750 for the shares. Each ADS equals one class D share of capital stock.

The offering will be made through Salomon Brothers, the filing said. All of the shares are being sold by the Argentine government acting through the Ministry of Economy and Public Works and Services which holds the shares for the benefit of certain employees of YPF.
The agents for the participating employees are Comafi Bursatil S.A. Sociedad de Bolsa and MBA Sociedad de Bolsa S.A.

After the offering, outstanding Class D will total 264,844,914 shares. The rise in the number of Class D shares outstanding after the offering is due to the conversion of 35.3 million Class C shares into 35.3 million Class D shares.

The company will not receive any of the proceeds. However, of the total amount, about $582.5 million will be allocated to the Argentine government in payment of outstanding balance of the deferred purchase price for such shares under the share purchase plan.
The employees will receiving the balance, net of expenses and underwriting discounts, the filing said.

YPF, based in Buenos Aires, is an integrated oil and gas company engaged in the exploration, development and production of oil and natural gas and in the refining, marketing, transportation and distribution of oil and a wide range of petroleum products.
